svg.title: Aishwarya’s Contribution Metropolis
svg.desc: 33 contributions across 371 calendar days. One block per day; zero activity is an empty platform. Height is proportional to log2(count plus one), normalized to this calendar. GitHub GraphQL contributionCalendar.

g.text: Height = log-scaled count · Roof = activity band · Tallest = busiest day
Calendar activity is not a measure of code quality. Private counts depend on GitHub visibility.
